sketch: Generalize the existing Fallow envelopes and `yeet-flake-quarantine/v1` incident artifact into a `ci-failure-capsule/v1` Effect Schema emitted by every `beep ci lane` wrapper on nonzero exit. Each capsule binds the failure to workflow, job, run attempt, commit SHA, base SHA, runner image/toolchain versions, sanitized environment and cache fingerprints, exact command and cwd, relevant input/Turbo hashes, bounded log excerpts, and artifact references. An `always()` workflow step validates the capsule before uploading it under a deterministic lane-and-attempt name; failure to produce a valid capsule becomes a distinct CI contract failure. `yeet monitor` downloads and decodes capsules, deduplicates them by failure fingerprint, maps the resubmission label such as `fix:code`, `retry:infra`, or `reproduce:local` into an agent route, and records the result in its existing status and closeout artifacts. A suspected flaky lane moves from required to quarantined only through an operator-approved policy entry backed by a capsule whose recorded command fails and then passes under controlled repeated replay, while a stable meta-check remains required and reports the quarantine explicitly. Because main is squash-merged and merge order is operator-controlled, capsule identity must bind to the PR head and base pair so a later merge invalidates stale reproduction evidence.
risk: The load-bearing risk is that incomplete environment capture or an overly permissive replay rule misclassifies a real code regression as infrastructure flakiness, turning quarantine into a branch-protection bypass; fingerprints must be secret-safe, head/base-bound, and promotion out of required status must remain operator-approved and time-bounded.
first_step: Add `FailureCapsule`, `FailureFingerprint`, and `ResubmissionLabel` schemas beside `packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Quality/internal/FlakeQuarantine.ts`, plus round-trip and redaction tests, then make one representative `beep ci lane` emit and validate the capsule on a forced failure before changing any required-check policy.

children.text: Capsule replay command: `bun run beep ci reproduce <capsule>` reconstructs the lane locally or in a disposable hosted runner and writes a linked reproduction verdict.
Failure exchange: deduplicate identical fingerprints across PRs so one fixer agent owns the root cause while dependent PRs subscribe to its resolution.
Quarantine escrow: every relaxed required check is replaced by a required meta-check that enforces owner, expiry, replay count, and a tracked repair issue.
Merge-order simulation: replay capsules against candidate base SHAs to tell the operator which pending squash merge will invalidate or resolve failures downstream.
Capsule-derived routing metrics: measure time from failure to deterministic reproduction and fix by lane, parser confidence, and resubmission label instead of counting raw CI retries.
